learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise for the complete processing of design tasks for complex and novel machines and products.

syllabus_topics: Design and dimensioning of components and assemblies for manufacturing and assembly
Design and dimensioning of components and assemblies considering force flow and stress
Application of knowledge regarding machine elements
Definition of requirements for design tasks
Conception of simple to moderately complex machines
Constructive design of simple to moderately complex machines
Preparation of a written final report
assessment_rules: The graded performance is based on a 120-minute written exam. The weighting of the graded performance for the sub-modules MABB331 : MABB332 : MABB333 is 1 : 1 : 0. The study achievement for Konstruktionsübung 1 (MABB333) consists of an ungraded semester-long project work completed by students in small groups. Active participation in the project, attendance at multiple milestone meetings, and submission of a final report are mandatory. This study achievement must be passed but does not contribute to the module grade.
bibliography: Wittel, H. et al.: Roloff/Matek Maschinenelemente – Normung, Berechnung, Gestaltung. Springer 2017
